reason: I already pay my admin to type the scooter receipts into Excel every week, and late or not it works and costs me nothing extra. I might throw a few receipts at the free 30 to see what happens, but I wouldn't pay $19 or $35 a month this month for something Zoho or a bot I could build myself might do.
objection: Half my spending is cash to mechanics with a scribbled note or no receipt at all, plus fuel slips and parts from little shops. I doubt a bot reads a mechanic's handwriting in Indonesian correctly, and if my admin still has to check every row, I've saved nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If the free 30 documents read my mechanics' handwritten notes and fuel slips correctly and my admin could stop the weekly typing, I'd pay the $35 tier.
